name: PhyXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Eight filters in the style of classic synths (MS-20, SEM, Minimoog, Matrix-12, 2600, Wasp, prologue, Polivoks) in one effect. Route audio from any filter into any other, and modulate each one from ten sources through a touch patch bay or a matrix. 28 factory patches. By L'Cronx, GPL-3. No third-party code; not made or endorsed by any maker of the originals.
